test_title: PYST 61: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. One of them contains an error. Select the segment that contains the error from the given options.

Last night I dreamed that / I am looking for the/ abominable snowman high / up in the Himalayas.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the third part of the given sentence, the present tense form of the verb 'am looking' is incorrect.
 
• The sentence is in the past tense, as indicated by **'Last night I dreamed that'.**
 
• Therefore, the correct form should be 'was looking' to match the past tense context.

Hence, the correct statement is: ***Last night I dreamed that I was looking for__ the abominable snowman high up in the Himalayas*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When describing past events or dreams, it is essential to maintain the past tense throughout the sentence.
 
• Using the correct tense helps in maintaining the consistency and clarity of the sentence.
